lines.en: Clank clank
Rumble softly
Snap crackle
Spin forward
Grind teeth threat
Eye glowing stare

lines.zh: 我磕着地板一路滑过来。
lines.en: I clatter along the floor toward you.
Hunger growl
Search hum
Low roar
It spins on its rim, knocking the ground.
It hobbles over in little jolts.

lines.zh: 碗里的东西，正在慢慢晃。
lines.en: What is in this bowl sloshes slowly.
Weak sound

lines.zh: 桌上的灰落进我空碗里。
lines.en: Dust from the table falls into my empty bowl.
Spinning bowl
Occasional sound
Seems thinking

lines.zh: 碗底转了一圈，声音很轻。
lines.en: My bowl turns once with a faint sound.
Occasional twitch

lines.zh: 碗底那道裂纹又长了一点。
lines.en: The crack in my base lengthens a little.
I hang by the table corner, slowly turning.

lines.zh: 我用碗里的倒影锁住你。
lines.en: I lock onto you with the reflection in my bowl.

lines.zh: 我悬在你面前，打量你的手。
lines.en: I hover before you and study your hands.
The bowl turns and frames your feet.
Mouth open to bite
Warning sound

lines.zh: 我停在你影子边上，不动了。
lines.en: I stop at the edge of your shadow and go still.
Fierce eyes
Threatening sound
Extending arms
Moving to player

lines.zh: 碗裂开了，发出尖锐的叫声！
lines.en: The bowl shatters, emitting a sharp cry!
The shards cut me, it hurts!
The broken bowl pierced my skin!

lines.zh: 碗边割伤了我，血流出来了！
lines.en: The bowl edge cut me, blood is flowing!
The broken shards stabbed into my body!
The bowl shattered, it hurts!
The bowl edge cut me, it hurts a lot!
The bowl shards pierced my flesh!

lines.zh: 碗的碎片割伤了我，好痛！
lines.en: The bowl shards cut me, it hurts!

lines.zh: 碗碎了，扎进了我的血肉！
lines.en: The broken bowl shards pierced my flesh!
Tempt me, and watch out!
Souls call out from the bowl!

lines.zh: 吃了我的灵魂，你会更强！
lines.en: Eat my soul, and grow stronger!
Don’t think you’ll get away with it!
My power lies in the soul!

lines.zh: 你把食物放进去，我就饶你。
lines.en: Drop food in me and I may spare you.
My existence is a threat!
You can’t resist my temptation!
My possessed bowl is a weapon!
Don’t make me strike first!
Watch out for my bowl!
My bowl will shatter you!
Don’t block my attack!
My bowl is deadly!

lines.zh: 我的碗沿崩掉一块，还照样撞。
lines.en: A chip flies off my rim, and I still charge.

lines.zh: 一只空碗撞上来，你也疼。
lines.en: An empty bowl can still hurt.

lines.zh: 我这只碗，边口是锋利的。
lines.en: This bowl's rim is sharp.

lines.zh: 我撞在你膝盖上，碎了一声。
lines.en: I hit your knee and crack with a snap.
My bowl will end you!

lines.zh: 碗里装着不该装的东西。
lines.en: This bowl holds something it shouldn't.

lines.zh: 碗里那点东西，也想找伴。
lines.en: What's left in this bowl wants company too.
My kind is nearby!
Don’t go alone!
Let’s hunt together!
My kind is coming!
Find my soul!
My kind are dangerous!
My kind will help you!

lines.zh: 架子上的碗碟，都在发抖。
lines.en: Every bowl on the shelf is trembling.
Find my partner!

lines.zh: 我从黑暗中爬出，准备吞噬一切！
lines.en: I crawl from the darkness, ready to devour all!

lines.zh: 你尝尝被附身的滋味吧！
lines.en: Feel the taste of possession!
Seeking your weakness, here I come!
Break, your armor!
Your flesh is my food!
I am the eternal curse!
The bowl is empty, so I take your soul first.
Despair, mortal!
In the darkness, only I exist!
Nobody touches the soup at the bottom of this bowl.
I sense your fear!
The soup inside me rolls in a ring.

lines.zh: 碗底空了，死亡就在边上。
lines.en: The bowl is empty, and death is at its rim.
The rim faces you and spins faster.
Your scent betrays you!

lines.zh: 橱柜里的气味，混着你的汗。
lines.en: The smell of the cupboard mixes with your sweat.
Your end is coming!
Do not resist!
The shadow of death falls upon you!
Fear will consume your soul!
The broth in the bowl sloshes once.
It turns its base toward you.
The bowl opens its mouth at you.
It has heard your footsteps.

lines.zh: 碗里浮出一张模糊的脸
lines.en: A blurred face surfaces in the bowl.

lines.zh: 它认准了这屋子里的人
lines.en: It has picked out the one inside the house.
Rip your flesh!

lines.zh: 我晃得汤水都溅到碗外。
lines.en: I rattle so hard the broth splashes out.
Feel the cold of death!

lines.zh: 我找碗口最薄的一处对着你。
lines.en: I aim the thinnest part of my rim at you.

lines.zh: 一只碗，也能咬住你的脚。
lines.en: A bowl can still bite your ankle.
Break, rot, and vanish!
You will be my puppet!

lines.zh: 一只碗，也能装下你的恐惧。
lines.en: Even a bowl can hold your fear.
Your screams will awaken the dead!
Death will be everywhere!
The bowl starts to tremble hard.
It circles your table leg.
The broth swirls inside it.
Its rim taps out a rapid rhythm.
It tenses as if about to spring.
The shadow in the bowl stretches out.

lines.zh: 它对准你的小腿发起抖
lines.en: It quivers, aimed at your shin.
It seeks its thinnest chipped edge.
The sound of cracking porcelain nears.
It presses itself even lower.

lines.zh: 尖锐的瓷片刮过你的皮肤。
lines.en: Sharp porcelain slices your skin.
Broken bowl flies at you.
Food-stained bowl collides with you.
You are cut by a shattered bowl.

lines.zh: 碗中的怨灵嘶吼着攻击你。
lines.en: The ghost in the bowl screams at you.

lines.zh: 碗里的尖刺扎进你的肉里。
lines.en: Sharp spines pierce your flesh.

lines.zh: 碗突然从地上跳起攻击你。
lines.en: The bowl leaps up to attack you.

lines.zh: 碎碗碎片扎进你的身体。
lines.en: Shards of broken bowls pierce you.
The ghost in the bowl growls angrily.

lines.zh: 你被粘满鲜血的碗袭击。
lines.en: You are attacked by a bloody bowl.
Its rim slices across your instep.
It smashes into your knee.
Porcelain shards burst against the wall.
The bowl slams into your palm.
It rolls in and strikes your ankle.
A shard opens a cut on you.
Its base slams into your face.
It cracks its own rim on you.
The broth spills across your leg.
It leaps and clips your jaw.

lines.zh: 碗中突然发出鬼哭狼嚎。
lines.en: Ghostly cries echo from the bowl.
The bowl cracks, and ghosts spill out.

lines.zh: 附身的碗慢慢从地面升起。
lines.en: The possessed bowl rises from the ground.

lines.zh: 碗中怨灵低语，开始移动。
lines.en: Ghosts whispering in the bowl start moving.
The bowl glows, and ghosts awaken.
Ghosts coalesce within the bowl.
The ghost bowl slowly moves.
Ghosts murmur inside the bowl.

lines.zh: 碗在空中划过一道诡异的轨迹。
lines.en: The bowl moves in a strange arc through the air.

lines.zh: 碗中怨灵苏醒，准备攻击。
lines.en: Ghosts awaken within the bowl, ready to attack.
An empty bowl stands itself up.
Something scrapes inside the cupboard.
My rim cracked; the soup spilled.
Fell from a height, the bowl shattered!
Drowned in water, the bowl shattered!
Shattered by the explosion, it hurts!
Struck by a projectile, it hurts!
Struck by magic, the bowl shattered!
Starved and weak, the bowl shattered!
Struck by lightning, the bowl shattered!
Fell into the void, the bowl shattered!
